_help: EDIT THIS FILE to change the navbar, brand, footer, page text, example links and the model-comparison table. Save the file and refresh the browser - no restart needed. Keep the JSON valid: text in double quotes, commas between items. See EDITING_GUIDE.md.

nav._help: Each item: label + page (a name from EDITING_GUIDE.md) OR url (http/https/mailto or /path). style: '' (plain link), 'outline' (bordered) or 'button'. Remove an item to hide it; add one to show it.

footer.text: PhishGuard AI · Research demo · Predictions are probabilistic and are not security guarantees.

models_page._help: source: 'manual' = show the numbers typed in the 'manual' list below (edit them here), 'csv' = read them from models/<csv_file> written by the notebook. columns: any of Accuracy, F1, Precision, Recall, AUC. decimals: digits after the point (0-4). hide_models: names to leave out. sort: 'accuracy_desc' (best first) or 'as_listed' (keep the order you typed). Write values as percentages, e.g. 96.54.
